name: swiftcn-ui
summary: Copy-paste SwiftUI component library inspired by shadcn/ui, with light and dark themes.
description: A SwiftUI playground of copy-paste components inspired by shadcn/ui — avatar, badge, button, card, input, progress, slider, tabs and toggle, styled for light and dark mode. Calendar, skeleton and textarea are marked work-in-progress and an X home screen clone is included as an example. No package install: clone the repo, open Swiftcn Playground.swiftpm in Xcode and slide.
contains: 9 SwiftUI components: avatar, badge, button, card, input, progress, slider, tabs, toggle
calendar, skeleton and textarea components marked work-in-progress
example screens: X home clone done, Spotify work-in-progress
runs as a Swift playground you open in Xcode
no package install — copy the components you need
repository is looking for a maintainer
